# ICSE SEET 2027 — Important Dates

| Event | Date |
|---|---|
| **Submissions deadline** | **23 October 2026**, 23:59 **AoE** (Anywhere on Earth, UTC-12) |
| **Acceptance notification** | 18 December 2026 |
| **Camera ready** | 19 January 2027 |

- Submissions are made via HotCRP: https://icse2027-seet.hotcrp.com
- Authors are encouraged to **enter paper metadata early** (and upload the PDF later) so conflict-of-interest entries for double-anonymous review are registered correctly.

> These dates concern ICSE SEET **2027** and become stale after the conference concludes.
